<thought>Applying template 1914397 to the target SMILES yields a single pair of precursors: “CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCNCC1” and “O=[N+]([O-])c1cc(Br)c2c(c1)CCC1(CCC1)O2”. The required format is a list of lists, each inner list containing the SMILES strings of one possible precursor combination.</thought>
<final_answer>[[\"CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCNCC1\", \"O=[N+]([O-])c1cc(Br)c2c(c1)CCC1(CCC1)O2\"]]</final_answer>
